items.summary: Update backend access-control initialization so that calls to `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret` from the frontend during authenticated actor creation never trap when the provided secret is empty/invalid, and do not prevent the actor from being created/usable for normal authenticated user actions (including `submitStory`).

Ensure any authenticated principal can obtain the `#user` permission required by user endpoints (at minimum `submitStory`, `addComment`, `addReview`, `getMySubmissions`, `getCallerUserProfile`, and `saveCallerUserProfile`) without requiring an admin token, using the existing initialization flow already invoked by the frontend.

Keep `checkBackendHeartbeat()` callable without authentication and ensure it reliably returns `true` without trapping so frontend availability checks can consistently distinguish backend reachability from other failures.
Perform final pre-release verification in the deployed environment to confirm the app is ready to publish/go live, including the end-to-end authenticated submission flow and key user interactions.
